answer.text: A predictable daily return within 1 sigma
A large, unexpected, high-impact event that has low-probability but severe consequences

explanation.text: The Logic: Taleb's black-swan definition: rare, high-impact, narratively explained ex-post. VaR/stress testing cannot prevent black swans; only robust portfolio construction can mitigate. The Trap: Daily within-1-sigma is normal noise; 5% VaR breach is routine tail event, not a black swan. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-B-specific framing. Manager's Pro-Tip: Design portfolios to SURVIVE black swans, not PREDICT them — keep cash reserves and avoid over-leverage.
